

# events

The client mounts the feed supplied by `data-src`. The feed endpoint supplies
rendered event HTML; the client updates countdowns and map links in that HTML.
The registry serves this coral through its versioned channel.

<!-- coral metadata: start (generated by catalog-readme.mjs) -->
## events metadata

Shows the upcoming events of a calendar feed. A feed that carries the calendar as data (`events`) is drawn in the browser: what's-next order, dates and relative times in the page's language from Intl, a timed event on the visitor's clock, a title that links to the location, and add-to-calendar on the date tile, the date line and the badge. A feed that carries only `html` is shown as it came.

Author: `official`.

### Embed

```html
<div data-dynamic-coral="events" data-src="/events.json"></div>
<script type="module" src="https://feelreef.com/corals/events/v0/events.js"></script>
```

### Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Required | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data-dynamic-coral` | enum | yes | — | Selects the events coral. Values: `events`. |
| `data-src` | url | no | `/events.json` | JSON event feed URL. With `events` in the response the list is drawn in the browser; a `show=` in this address is the row count when `data-show` is not set. |
| `data-show` | string | no | — | How many events to list, 1 to 20 (default 5), for a feed drawn in the browser. Without it, the feed address's own `show=` is used. |
| `data-empty` | string | no | `No upcoming events.` | Text shown for an empty feed, fetch failure, or non-ok response. |
| `data-in-prefix` | string | no | `in ` | Static `html` feeds only: prefix for upcoming countdowns. A feed drawn in the browser takes these words from Intl. |
| `data-live-label` | string | no | `Now` | Static `html` feeds only: text for an event happening now. A feed drawn in the browser takes this word from Intl. |
| `data-countdown` | enum | no | — | Set to always to keep the badge on events more than a week away. |
